contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of 330-340, Trier mint, Reece period 17, RIC vol. 7 page 217 no. 543; if so, issue of 332-333. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma cuirassed or mantled left. Obverse inscription: [VR]BS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: probably TRS*. Diameter: 15.8mm, Weight: 1.66gms, die axis: 6
